4247-5972-5973.easyPrerequisites:
Griffin Guide attached to another creature you control.
You control an additional creature beyond those included above and the one that has Griffin Guide attached.
4247-5972-5973.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the creature with Griffin Guide attached.
When the creature dies, Cass and Griffin Guide trigger.
Resolve the Griffin Guide trigger, creating a 2/2 Griffin creature token.
Resolve the Cass trigger, returning Griffin Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2719-3908.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2719-3908.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Spark Double and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2719-3908.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1809-1987-6259.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1809-1987-6259.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Returned Pastcaller.
When Returned Pastcaller enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1809-1987-6259.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1987-2239-3075.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-2239-3075.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters
1987-2239-3075.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Ardent Elementalist.
When Ardent Elementalist enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2239-3075.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

215-4188-4885.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 6 life this turn.
215-4188-4885.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Accomplished Alchemist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Accomplished Alchemist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4186-6719-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4186-6719-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-4681-5170-6772.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Syr Vondam triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

280-433-3259--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
280-433-3259--85--106.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1651-6753-7318.description:
Activate Coin of Mastery by tapping it, creating two Treasure tokens due to Exalted Sunborn.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two tokens, untapping Coin of Mastery.
Repeat.

546-1409-4613-7237.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 5 life this turn.
546-1409-4613-7237.description:
Activate Voracious Wurm by paying {1}{U}, blinking it. Voracious Wurm enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
When Voracious Wurm enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Voracious Wurm.
Activate Voracious Wurm using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

628-6798-7215.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Gnarlbark Elm.
When Gnarlbark Elm dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

1879-3259-7208.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1879-3259-7208.description:
Declare Pestered Wellguard and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers. Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Faerie token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

4195-4211-4574-5849.description:
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Tormod's Crypt from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

997-2232-3821-6843.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
997-2232-3821-6843.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Anti-Venom by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
When Anti-Venom enters, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Anti-Venom trigger, returning Peregrine Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Anti-Venom from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Peregrine Drake.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

2760-3108-4753.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Clever Impersonator.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Clever Impersonator by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2486-5641-6012.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Reluctant Role Model's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

1174-1479-6662.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control two lands that can tap to produce at least {2}, one of which must enter the battlefield untapped.
1174-1479-6662.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning one of the lands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the other land.
Play the land returned to your hand in step 2.
When the land enters the battlefield, Kodama and Chocobo Racetrack trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers.
Holding priority, activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning one of the lands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the other land.
Resolve the Kodama trigger from step 7, putting the land returned to your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Chocobo Racetrack triggers, creating a token.
Repeat from step 7.

892-2743-6570.description:
Cast Mnemonic Deluge by paying {6}{U}{U}{U}, exiling Sublime Epiphany and casting three copies of it without paying their mana costs.
Resolve the three Sublime Epiphany copies, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

1458-3152--62.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that does not have summoning sickness.
1458-3152--62.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting any creature you control without summoning sickness.
Cast the permanent by paying {0}.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning the permanent cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
1458-3152--62.notes: You will only get infinite ETB and LTB triggers if you choose a creature as the permanent.

1247-3918-3941.description:
Activate Trazyn using Coveted Jewel's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

1651-4321-4639-5251.description:
Activate Unctus by paying {U/P}, causing Emmara to become a blue artifact until end of turn.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Emmara and another artifact, targeting Emmara.
Emmara triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Emmara.
Repeat from step 2.

784-1750-2099-2793-5261.notablePrerequisites: Silas Renn cannot be blocked by an opponent.
784-1750-2099-2793-5261.description:
Activate Sarcatog's second ability by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
When Ugin's Nexus is sacrificed, it is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Ugin's Nexus from exile into your graveyard.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Silas Renn, triggering Silas Renn, targeting Ugin's Nexus.
Cast Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard by paying {5}.
Repeat.

618-2595-4613.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one other creature that has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and that does not have summoning sickness.
Combine Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.
618-2595-4613.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, causing each creature you control to enter the battlefield with an additional +1/+1 counter on it this turn.
Activate a creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it using Kiki-Jiki's ability by tapping it, creating a token copy of any nonlegendary creature you control with haste that enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Repeat step 2.

2232-2440-3433-4758.description:
Cast Hornet Queen by paying {4}{G}{G}{G}.
When Hornet Queen enters the battlefield, it, Cloudstone Curio, and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Hornet Queen trigger, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
When the Insects enter the battlefield, Mana Echoes and Cloudstone Curio each trigger four times.
Resolve the first Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Hornet Queen from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve all remaining Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {5} for each Insect you control.
Activate Crossroads Candleguide three times by paying {6}, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

67-2517-5256-5276.notablePrerequisites: Parallax Wave has at least one fade counter on it.
67-2517-5256-5276.description:
Activate Parallax Wave by removing a fade counter from it, exiling Reveillark.
When Reveillark leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Parallax Wave.
When Parallax Wave leaves the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Parallax Wave from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Leonin Relic-Warder's power.
Resolve the Parallax Wave trigger from step 4, returning Reveillark from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4289-4687-4893.notablePrerequisites: Gilder Bairn does not have summoning sickness.
4289-4687-4893.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

3719-4365-4499.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with power seven or greater.
3719-4365-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Ruthless Technomancer.
When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice a nontoken creature you control with power seven or greater, and create at least fourteen Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing at least seven Treasures, returning a nontoken creature you control with power seven or greater from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1283-3146-4279-4929.notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1283-3146-4279-4929.description:
Activate Yawgmoth's second ability by paying {2} and discarding Voidwing Hybrid, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Voidwing Hybrid triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {2} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

2043-3621-5256.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the token Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2034-2835-4963.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
2034-2835-4963.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Fecundity.
Holding priority, activate Words of Wilding by paying {1}, causing you to create a 2/2 Bear creature token the next time you would draw a card this turn.
Resolve the Fecundity trigger, creating a 2/2 Bear creature token.
Repeat.

1003-2232-3661-5043.description:
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Alela triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
The Faerie enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Shield Sphere from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Alela triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
The Faerie enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Phyrexian Walker from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

262-4038-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Farmstead Gleaner.
Farmstead Gleaner does not have summoning sickness.
262-4038-4050.description:
Activate Farmstead Gleaner by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste equal to its power.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Elemental tokens, adding {2}.
Activate Farmstead Gleaner by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2250-2302.description:
Painter's Servant causes all creature spells to be blue in addition to their other colors.
Because Llawan prevents your opponent from casting blue creature spells, they are unable to cast creature spells.

888-932-3609.notablePrerequisites: Magistrate's Scepter has three charge counters on it.
888-932-3609.description:
Activate Magistrate's Scepter, removing 3 charge counters to take an extra turn.
Activate Tawnos, copying the extra turn ability.
Pass the turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Energy Chamber triggers, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter, putting a charge counter on itself.
Activate Tawnos, copying the trigger.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
